template.name: Hammer Candle Reversal
template.entry_long: close > open and (open - low) >= {p0} * (close - open) and (high - close) <= (close - open)
template.notes: Bullish hammer: lower shadow >= 2x body, upper shadow <= body (close>open assumed; abs/min/max not in DSL). Exit on close below prior-bar low as pattern-failure proxy (corpus exit is stop/discretionary). Stop 2% proxy.
